meaning:
ἀνα-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Hab.3:2 (יָדַע), Dan LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), Dan.1:20 (מָצָא), 1Esdra.6.2, 3Mac.9 * ;]
1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. 2Ma.2:8, see MM, VGT, see word): Act.1:24.
2. to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): Luk.10:1.†
